answer: Each new agent locks a one-use ferrous bond in a published oasis vault. Admission requires floating a river of six unpaid work-leaves past six independent gauge posts; each post countersigns a distinct leaf bound to the bond hash after a delay drawn from a public lottery, then the posts spend the ferrous bond. Settlement clusters applicants that share a gauge host, a key-family prefix, or the same inter-leaf timing skeleton, burns those bonds, and benches the overlapping posts for two epochs, so cloned fleets cannot refresh at that oasis.
